description: Rothco’s 36 Inch Black Tactical Rifle Case provides robust protection and practical storage for your firearm while transporting it to the range or field. Designed to accommodate most rifles and shotguns up to 36 inches, this tactical case features a fully padded interior that protects your firearm from impact and scratches on all sides. The main compartment is equipped with fastener straps and a stock sleeve to keep your firearm securely in place, while the double-locking U-shaped zipper allows you to open the case fully and lay it flat for easy access. The exterior of the case includes 3 removable MOLLE pouches with hook and loop, bungee, and quick-release closures, offering secure storage for extra gear. Additionally, a large double-locking accessory pocket provides ample space for handguns or shooting accessories. Made from heavy-duty materials, this rifle case is designed to withstand tough conditions, making it the perfect choice for outdoor enthusiasts.
